title: Striking Out
text: In the bottom of the ninth inning, Jake stepped up to the plate with the game on the line. His stomach had been growling all through practice, and he could not stop thinking about the plate of spaghetti waiting for him at home. The pitcher wound up and threw a fast pitch, and Jake swung hard but missed for his second strike. His coach called out that if lightning could strike twice, so could Jake's bat. Jake took a deep breath, choked up on the bat, and watched the next pitch carefully. This time he connected, and the ball sailed over the fence for a home run. Rounding the bases, all Jake could think about was finally sitting down at his own plate for dinner.
comprehension_hint_topics: the two different things called a plate in the story
what the coach meant about lightning striking twice
